meta.name: secure-code-guardian
meta.description: Use when implementing authentication/authorization, securing user input, or preventing OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities — including custom security implementations such as hashing passwords with bcrypt/argon2, sanitizing SQL queries with parameterized statements, configuring CORS/CSP headers, validating input with Zod, and setting up JWT tokens. Invoke for authentication, authorization, input validation, encryption, OWASP Top 10 prevention, secure session management, and security hardening. For pre-built OAuth/SSO integrations or standalone security audits, consider a more specialized skill.

copy.tagline: 保护应用免受常见安全漏洞侵害
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在代码中实现认证、授权或输入验证等安全措施
copy.tagline_en: Protect your app from common security vulnerabilities

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你编写安全的代码，比如用 bcrypt 加密密码、用参数化查询防止 SQL 注入、用 Zod 验证输入，并设置安全头。
howto.when: 当你要求实现身份验证、授权、输入验证、加密或防范 OWASP Top 10 漏洞时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 bcrypt 哈希用户密码。
say.note: Claude 会生成安全的密码哈希代码。

say.text: 写一个防止 SQL 注入的登录接口。
say.note: Claude 会使用参数化查询实现。

say.text: 为我的 Express 应用配置 CSP 头。
say.note: Claude 会添加 helmet 中间件设置安全头。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you write secure code, such as hashing passwords with bcrypt, preventing SQL injection with parameterized queries, validating input with Zod, and setting security headers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to implement authentication, authorization, input validation, encryption, or prevent OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.

say_en.text: Help me hash user passwords with bcrypt.
say_en.note: Claude will generate secure password hashing code.

say_en.text: Write a login endpoint that prevents SQL injection.
Configure CSP headers for my Express app.
